about: Link table between AMSAT status entries and the SatNOGS database, for Northbound (github.com/TF5NN/sat-track). Draft made automatically on 2026-11-17; see the accompanying notes for what needs checking.

entries.note: No NORAD number found by name in the AMSAT orbit file or SatNOGS.

review.comment: AO-129 is ERMINAZ-2U (AMSAT digipeater page). It launched on Transporter-18 on 2026-10-01 as NORAD 101098 (COSPAR 2026-227CL), a number taken from a third-party tracker's catalogue listing. I found no SatNOGS entry. It uses 9k6 GMSK with a special frame structure and needs AMSAT's linked decoder. 0/5 heard.

howToFill.verdict: One of: "confirmed" (the suggestion is right), "corrected" (use the values in this block instead), "leave out" (not usable or not active), "unsure" (could not establish).
howToFill.norad: The NORAD catalogue number, only if missing or wrong above. A temporary SatNOGS number (90000 and up) does not count.
howToFill.satnogsUuid: The uuid of the SatNOGS transmitter entry to use, taken from "candidates" or "allActiveEntries" or from db.satnogs.org. Preferred over typing frequencies, because the app will then follow SatNOGS updates.
howToFill.frequencies: Only if SatNOGS has no usable entry. MHz, with a high value only for a passband. "inverting" applies to linear transponders.
howToFill.tone: CTCSS tone in Hz for FM repeaters, if one is needed.
howToFill.sources: Web addresses that support the answer: the operator's page, AMSAT, IARU coordination, SatNOGS. At least one for anything corrected or filled.
howToFill.rule: Do not guess. If sources disagree or nothing recent can be found, use "unsure" and say why in the comment.

reviewNotes: Reviewed 2026-11-17. Main systematic finding: SatNOGS often keeps new satellites under a temporary number (90000+) and puts the real NORAD number in norad_follow_id. The draft matched only norad_cat_id, which is why ARICA-2, CO-128, Marina, RS83S, Luca and JAMX01 looked missing or temporary. Matching on norad_follow_id, and on alternate names such as FO-126, would catch most of these automatically. In-app review blocks got an extra satnogsUuid field where a link is chosen.
